sources.title: Qwen3-4B - Qualcomm AI Hub
sources.snippet: Qwen3-4B State‑of‑the‑art large language model useful on a variety of language understanding and generation tasks. The Qwen3‑4B is a state‑of‑the‑art multilingual base language model with 4 billion parameters, excelling in language understanding, generation, coding, and mathematics.

sources.title: Qwen3-4B: Open-Source 4B LLM with Thinking Mode - DEV.co
sources.snippet: Qwen3-4B is a freely licensed, 4-billion-parameter LLM with switchable thinking/non-thinking modes, multilingual support, and agent capabilities. Deploy locally or in the cloud with vLLM, SGLang, or Ollama.

sources.title: Qwen3-4B: Specifications and GPU VRAM Requirements
sources.snippet: About Qwen3-4B Qwen3-4B is a 4-billion parameter dense causal language model developed by Alibaba, belonging to the third generation of the Qwen series. A fundamental innovation in this model is its unified architecture that supports dual-mode operation, allowing for dynamic switching between 'thinking' and 'non-thinking' states.
